body: Severe weather events surged with flash floods in Arizona and Colorado and catastrophic flooding in Ecuador linked to El Niño, underscoring accelerating climate impacts.
The lawsuit over a fatal ChatGPT misguidance incident highlights the growing real‑world dangers of AI misuse, while a DW report flags AI‑enabled biological weapon concerns.

Geopolitical tensions rose sharply with Iran’s IRGC reporting two tankers exploding after hitting mines in the Strait of Hormuz and Russia’s near‑completion of a giant radar in Kaliningrad, both heightening the risk of military escalation.

experts.say: Tensions around Iran and the Strait of Hormuz persist, with reports of tankers hitting mines (21) and heightened diplomatic activity, but no new nuclear weapons developments or tests were reported.

Recent extreme weather reports – flash floods in Arizona and Colorado, heavy‑rain flood risk across the US Southwest, and catastrophic Ecuador floods linked to El Niño – indicate worsening climate impacts in the last day.
No new disease outbreaks, lab incidents, or antimicrobial resistance issues reported; the only bio news was the negative Ebola test in Nigeria, which does not increase risk.

The fatal ChatGPT misguidance lawsuit (20) shows real AI misuse harming individuals, and the DW piece on AI‑enabled biological weapons (13) highlights emerging existential threats. Both indicate heightened risk today.

Escalations rose with Iran’s IRGC reporting two tankers exploding in Hormuz, the Kherson cease‑fire ending and power cuts in Ukraine, Russia advancing a giant radar near Kaliningrad heightening NATO tensions, and Gulf leaders scrambling to prevent a new US‑Iran clash.
